rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Priya Raman <priya.raman@fastmail.com> with subject "Re: Offer of help". It read: "Hi Priya, Thank you, that's a generous offer and the timing is good. (I'm an assistant helping Morgan run Halcyon Threshold. Morgan will follow up personally.) The concrete project we're starting is a small, open dataset that tracks what frontier AI developers claim about safety testing when they release models: which evals they report, which thresholds and commitments they state, any third-party testing, and whether outsiders can verify the claims. It's mostly careful reading and structured coding, which suits a data analyst well. Suggested first task, about 5 hours: pilot the draft schema on 5 recent model releases from 3 different developers, and note every place the schema doesn't fit. I'll send you the schema itself once Morgan has looked at it. Does that sound interesting? There's no obligation either way. Best, Halcyon Threshold (on behalf of Morgan Hale)"
rows.quote: Priya Raman: she offered about 5 hours a week, so I replied. I said I'm an assistant helping you, described the project, suggested a first task of trying the layout on 5 recent model releases, and said you'd follow up personally.
